role: Header reader for the oracle's worldgen stage dumps (make -C oracle chunks): parses manifest.json (seed, x0/z0/x1/z1, step) and opens one gzip stream per stage.
notes: Included by test_dims.c, test_seedworld.c and test_worldgen.c. dump_open keeps a static 4 MB manifest buffer (line 35) and exits(2) on any read error. The java entries name the oracle writers of the format, not vanilla files; the member names there are format parts, not Java members.
